brief:
Drop Site News reported that Democrats are pushing to replace Chuck Schumer as Senate majority leader. The effort reflects internal party divisions over strategy and direction in the chamber.

Meanwhile, the humanitarian crisis in Gaza has deepened, with 94 percent of the population requiring shelter assistance, according to Drop Site News. The figure represents a near-total dependence on aid for basic housing across the territory.

In Paraguay, the president has resigned from office, though Drop Site News provided no further detail on the circumstances or successor.
title: Senate Democrats explore replacing Schumer as leader
